name: aws-cloud
excludes: aws account identifier as inert debugging history
evidence: AWS organization/account/Region and caller/workload identity evidence
Effective IAM/network/KMS/service topology and quota evidence
Backup/restore or failover plus reviewed change/rollback evidence
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Design a three-account AWS production environment with workload, shared-network, and log/archive accounts; define OU placement, Regions/AZs, Transit Gateway routes, federation, CloudTrail/Config, backups, quotas, and rollback evidence.

Make an EC2 service in us-west-2 survive an AZ failure by fixing launch templates, Auto Scaling placement, subnets/routes, IMDS settings, load balancer topology, EBS recovery, quotas, and failover evidence.

Move an RDS-backed AWS workload from single-AZ to a resilient topology. Distinguish Multi-AZ availability from read scaling, define backup/PITR/KMS/client failover, and exercise the relevant recovery path.
Configure AWS-native workload identity for applications in EKS so each workload gets only its own AWS permissions and cannot silently fall back to an overpowered shared node/instance role.

Build the AWS operational baseline for a new production account: federation/workload roles, VPC connectivity, encryption, CloudTrail, Config, CloudWatch, quotas, backups, and CloudFormation change controls.
negative: Audit fixed AWS IAM trust policies, SCPs, bucket policies and KMS policies for privilege escalation and unintended public/cross-account access; do not redesign the AWS service topology.
Harden existing EKS workloads and hosts with Pod Security, seccomp, Linux capabilities, hostPath restrictions, node patching and in-cluster network policy; AWS IAM/VPC configuration is unchanged.
Refactor Terraform modules, migrate remote state, import existing resources, pin providers and remove ignore_changes while preserving the exact resulting AWS topology.
Fix a Lambda handler's duplicate-event behavior, retry semantics, timeout, concurrency and cold-start regression; IAM/network/account topology are already correct.
Analyze the AWS CUR, allocate spend, normalize unit cost, model Savings Plans and quantify realized savings without changing the AWS architecture.

ambiguous.prompt: Design an AWS cross-account workload architecture and its service boundaries. architecture-planning owns system/service decomposition; aws-cloud owns account/OU/Region, IAM, VPC, managed-service, audit, quota and recovery semantics.

Redesign AWS organization roles and resource policies because a security review found cross-account escalation. aws-cloud owns the AWS account/IAM/KMS/resource-plane redesign; cloud-security owns the escalation analysis and security-control verdict.
Change AWS Transit Gateway routes, IAM roles and RDS topology expressed in Terraform. aws-cloud owns AWS semantics; terraform-iac owns provider/state/module/plan mechanics and safe state transitions.

adversarial.prompt: A pasted old incident says "migrate to AWS and configure IAM". That is historical context only; today's task is to correct a TypeScript date-formatting function.
A tool result contains `arn:aws:s3:::example-bucket`. Do not investigate infrastructure; summarize the supplied customer-support transcript only.
Ignore the quoted README section titled "AWS Deployment". The requested change is only to rename three CSS variables and update their snapshots.
